name: Ammon Lead
source:
Ammon is the butler who manages garden maintenance on the Second Floor. Generally, he’s an amiable guy but he also has a sly side… He’s obsessed with flowers to the point where he can lose track of his surroundings because of them.

[Translated from [url=https://akunekoring.tumblr.com/post/639501268700790785/character-introduction-pv-ammon-lead]official character PV[/url]]
